record.label: Plane-wave Hamiltonian for an α particle in hydrogen
record.description: Appendix G.1 specifies 218 electrons and one $\alpha$-particle projectile in a periodic cubic cell with 216 fixed protons. In plane-wave first quantization, each electron has integer momentum labels in $G=[-31,31]^3$. The projectile uses labels in $\tilde{G}=[-127,127]^3$ for momenta measured relative to its initial mean momentum $k_{\mathrm{proj}}$.
